key_insight: Variational optimization can compensate for imperfect optical hardware, achieving automated polarization compensation comparable to conventional methods.
engineering_relevance: Parameterized protocol optimization offers a practical route to calibrating noisy polarization-qubit hardware for quantum network nodes.
method: Parameterize prepare-and-measure protocols for variational optimization.
Optimize protocols experimentally on an optical testbed.
Compare gradient estimation methods and assess hardware imperfections and dark counts.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a proof-of-principle optical demonstration with polarization compensation comparable to conventional methods, but provides no numerical performance metrics.
watch_item: Performance on deployed fiber networks remains un demonstrated, and hardware imperfections and dark counts can affect optimization.
paper_title: Variational Quantum Optimization of Noisy Polarization Qubit Experiments
